sources.scope: Sections 17.1–17.3: TTS as conditional audio generation, neural codecs, quantization and token modeling.
Section 2: character input, autoregressive acoustic decoder with attention and mel-conditioned WaveNet.
Sections 2.2–2.3: duration from separate alignment, duration expansion, pitch and energy predictors.
Sections 3.1–3.2; Figure 2: monotone and surjective expansion, diffusion conditioning, training alignment and duration targets.
Author demo: the same utterance at different diffusion steps, intermediate mel spectra and vocoded audio.
Sections 2.1–2.3: mel-to-wave generator and multi-scale and multi-period discriminators.
V1 rates, hop size and sample rate.
Author demo: the same LJ Speech sentence across multiple vocoders.
Sections 2.1–2.2; Figure 1: linear spectrogram posterior, MAS, stochastic durations, latents and waveform inference.
Section 3: audio encoder, residual vector quantization and waveform decoder.
Sections 2.1–2.3; Figure 3: separate frame and within-frame autoregressive predictors.
CC BY 4.0 PMLR publication agreement and author/paper attribution in both locale captions.
